title: Power BI Permission and Role Change Audit
dataSources: Power BI admin refreshes (`powerbi:admin:refreshes`), admin API (`powerbi:admin:api`), gateway logs, and capacity metrics.
app: Power BI activity events from the Microsoft 365 / Purview audit log and the Power BI Admin & Fabric Capacity Metrics APIs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:api (activity="*Permissions*" OR activity="AddGroupMembers" OR activity="UpdateApp")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by user_email
| sort - changes
description: Audits Power BI events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for Power BI supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest Power BI admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities / audit log

grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in Power BI so unexpected changes can be traced.
